```{.r .cell-code}
# R/01_import_clean.R
import_data <- function() {
  # 1) 读 customer
  customer <- readr::read_csv(
    here::here("data", "customer_data.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()

  # 2) 读 transactions（大表：data.table 更快）
  transactions <- data.table::fread(
    here::here("data", "transactions_data.csv"),
    showProgress = TRUE
  ) %>%
    janitor::clean_names() %>%
    as_tibble()

  list(customer = customer, transactions = transactions)
}

check_basic <- function(customer, transactions) {
  cat("customer rows:", nrow(customer), "cols:", ncol(customer), "\n")
  cat("transactions rows:", nrow(transactions), "cols:", ncol(transactions), "\n")

  # schema quick look
  print(glimpse(customer))
  print(glimpse(transactions))

  # key checks
  stopifnot("customer_id" %in% names(customer))
  stopifnot("customer_id" %in% names(transactions))
  stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(customer$customer_id) == nrow(customer))

  # missingness overview
  print(skimr::skim(customer))
  print(skimr::skim(transactions))
}
# R/01_import_clean.R (继续加)
clean_data <- function(customer, transactions) {

  # 客户表：把日期字符串转 Date
  customer <- customer %>%
    mutate(
      across(contains("date"), ~ lubridate::ymd(.x)),
      across(contains("_tx"), ~ lubridate::ymd(.x))
    )

  # 交易表：日期 + 金额 + 类型
  transactions <- transactions %>%
    mutate(
      date = lubridate::ymd(date),
      amount = as.numeric(amount),
      type = as.factor(type)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(customer_id), !is.na(date), !is.na(amount))

  list(customer = customer, transactions = transactions)
}
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# R/02_aggregate_transactions.R
aggregate_transactions <- function(transactions) {

  tx_monthly_by_type <- transactions %>%
    mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
    group_by(month, type) %>%
    summarise(
      tx_n = n(),
      amt_sum = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      amt_avg = mean(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  tx_customer_monthly <- transactions %>%
    mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
    group_by(customer_id, month) %>%
    summarise(
      tx_n = n(),
      amt_sum = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      amt_avg = mean(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    tx_monthly_by_type = tx_monthly_by_type,
    tx_customer_monthly = tx_customer_monthly
  )
}
```
